errors.evidence: While the description correctly notes that units are not explicitly written, it fails to identify the values as percentages. This is strongly implied by the context of a survey distribution chart and the fact that the values shown (71.4, 20.9, 3.6, 0.6, 0.8, 2.7) sum to 100. Omitting the unit of measurement (percentage) is a major omission for a scientific chart description as it is key to understanding the data.
